messages:
Sam Chen: Quick design review: validation + destructive confirm for the new bulk label editor. Trying to land final copy and focus behaviour. Current mock: inline errors on fields, required asterisk hidden behind hover, and a modal confirm with 'Type DELETE to confirm' for bulk destructive actions. Thoughts?

Maya Lopez: 👀 Love the intent. Two immediate concerns: (1) hiding the required marker on hover is an a11y regression; screen readers won't pick it up consistently. (2) 'Type DELETE' is strong — are we doing it for every multi-item action? Might be heavy for power users.

Rob Patel: Agreed on a11y. We should show a visible "Required" label for mobile and attach `aria-required="true"` to inputs. For the modal, could we do a lighter confirmation for <50 items and escalate beyond that?

Li Wang: Inline errors are okay for single-field mistakes, but when users submit a 20-row batch with many missing labels we need a summary toast that lists rows and anchors to focusable inputs. Mobile view can't show full summary and we should scroll/focus to the first error.

a11y-bot: Reminder: when shifting focus to the first invalid field, ensure `aria-live` polite updates for the error message to announce to AT. Also avoid focus trapping that loses keyboard users from canceling.

Sam Chen: Re: modal — proposal: keep `Type DELETE` only when >100 items OR user is deleting across projects. Else use checkbox + primary CTA change to "Delete X items" and a single-line warning. Thoughts on copy tweaks?

Maya Lopez: For copy I'd prefer action-first CTA: "Delete 12 labels" and body: "This will remove the labels from 12 resources. This action cannot be undone." No all-caps typing unless escalation threshold hit. Also add secondary "Cancel" and tertiary "Export list" when >30.

Rob Patel: +1. Also copy for required fields: instead of asterisk-only use small "Required" helper text under field with `aria-hidden="false"` so it's visible and readable.

Li Wang: For errors UX: on submit, run validation, show compact summary at top with link anchors like "Row 3: missing label" — clicking focuses that input and announces via screen reader.

Sam Chen: Regarding focus behaviour for modal: focus should land in the confirm input if Type-to-confirm; if not, focus on primary button. Esc should close. If validation fails inside modal (e.g., missing reason), announce and focus first missing field.

Maya Lopez: Implementation note: use `focus-trap` lib but ensure it allows `Escape` and that focus return goes back to the original triggering button. Also keyboard-only users need visible focus rings on labels/buttons.

Rob Patel: Quick dev constraints: we can conditionally render the "Type DELETE" input server-side with an `escalationThreshold` param. I'll make an RFC with the thresholds and metrics.

Sam Chen: Action items: Maya to update copy + mobile tweaks; Rob to draft RFC for thresholds; Li to prototype summary anchor behaviour; I'll update mocks and open PR for a11y changes. Assigning to @Maya, @Rob, @Li. Thanks everyone :sparkles:

Maya Lopez: I'll do copy tomorrow and ping for a quick sync. :thumbsup:

Rob Patel: I'll start RFC draft today.

Li Wang: Prototyping now, will share a short Loom.

 a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist added to the thread: contrast, aria-required, focus order, live region announcements, focus return on modal close.
